items.information: **Português** O Summer Kube Boulevard Via Velha 2022 é o 13º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** Summer Kube Boulevard Via Velha 2022 is the 13th Official Championship of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, the cube may not be accepted for the competition.; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.name: Uppsala Open 2022

venue.name: Fyris Park
venue.details: The entrance facing the parking lot and the main road (route 55).

items.information: #### Svenska # Denna tävling har ställts in på grund av förändrade COVID-19 restriktioner. Välkomna till Uppsala Open 2022, en mysig endagstävling i Stenhagen, Uppsala. Det här är första gången en tävling hålls i Uppsala på 7 år! Glöm inte att läsa igenom alla flikar för viktig information gällande tävlingen. *Du får välja mellan att delta i antingen 6x6/7x7, eller 4bld/5bld. 4bld och 5bld kommer hållas på "Side stage", samtidigt som 6x6 och 7x7.* **På grund av regeringens nya restriktioner så kommer alla vuxna deltagare och gäster över 18 år behöva visa Covidbevis (vaccinationsbevis) för att få vistas i lokalen. Mer information om detta finns under fliken "COVID-19.** #### English # This competition has been cancelled due to a change in COVID-19 restrictions. Welcome to Uppsala Open 2022, a cozy one day competition in Stenhagen, Uppsala. This is the first time a competition is held in Uppsala in 7 years! Do not forget to read all of the tabs for important information regarding the competition. *You may choose to compete either in 6x6/7x7, or 4bld/5bld. 4bld and 5bld will be held at the side stage, at the same time as 6x6 and 7x7.* **Due to the Swedish government's new restrictions, all adult competitors and guests over the age of 18 will need to show a vaccination certificate to be allowed to be present at the venue. More information on this can be found under the tab "COVID-19.**
